description: Defines an immutable data class JLGGroupData for representing groups with clients in a collection sheet context, including methods for instantiation, equality, and client management.

classes.name: JLGGroupData
classes.description: Immutable data object for groups with clients due for disbursement or collection.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new JLGGroupData instance with specified group and staff details, without clients.

methods.name: withClients
methods.description: Creates a new JLGGroupData instance with specified clients.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated clients.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on groupId.
